contributions.anchor: the PER-PERIOD figure 'Contributions Received … This Period $ 15,958.71' on the p2 summary (the filer's own typed sheet, whose 'This Period' column occupies the legacy form's Column A slot and is restated in its Balance Summary as 'Total Contributions Received $ 15,958.71'), which is also the p3 ledger's own printed footer 'Total Contributions $ 15,958.71'
contributions.detail: 3 contribution rows sum to 4000.00 + 6652.20 + 5306.51 = 15,958.71 exactly = the ledger's own printed 'Total Contributions' line = the summary's per-period 'This Period' cell = the Balance Summary's 'Total Contributions Received'. The 'Year to Date' column prints 46,422.13 and is NOT summed as an increment. The balance ladder closes to the cent: 3,455.81 beginning + 15,958.71 = 19,414.52 subtotal; 19,414.52 - 15,394.57 = 4,019.95 close. THE LOAN QUESTION (ADDENDUM B §B3), resolved by the ladder and not by the wording: all three rows are captioned 'Kim Jackson Loan' — the candidate's own money — and they ARE itemized contribution rows here, because they sum to precisely the stated per-period contribution figure and the beginning balance (3,455.81) is an independent, already-occupied slot. Excluding them would leave the period's stated 15,958.71 with nothing behind it. This is a THIRD instance of the loan question and it resolves the Kirk/Grierson way, not the Witney way.

expenditures.anchor: the PER-PERIOD figure 'Expenditures Made … This Period $ 15,394.57' on the p2 summary (restated in its Balance Summary as 'Total Expenditures Made $ 15,394.57'), which is also the p4 ledger's own printed footer total '$ 15,394.57'
expenditures.detail: 16 expenditure rows sum to 35.29 + 55.00 + 50.22 + 43.44 + 20.27 + 3119.38 + 2626.24 + 78.52 + 29.00 + 15.00 + 38.65 + 85.00 + 5233.42 + 3740.14 + 150.00 + 75.00 = 15,394.57 exactly = the ledger's own printed total (which it prints unlabelled, under a rule, below the last row) = the summary's per-period cell = the Balance Summary line. The 'Year to Date' column prints 42,402.18 and is retained as cumulative, never summed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only, closed at the first test on both sides — the filer's own ledgers carry no in-kind column, no row is flagged in-kind, and the summary sheet prints no in-kind line, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions give identical sums (15,958.71 / 15,394.57), both equal to the stated per-period figures

itemized.notes: A NEW SOURCE PROPERTY FOR THE WAVE, and the 2014 analogue of Addendum A §A2: THE COUNTY'S COVER SHEET WITH THE CANDIDATE'S OWN TYPED SUMMARY AND SCHEDULES BEHIND IT. p1 IS the county's printed 2014 blank ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES'), completed in pencil/grey ink; p2, p3 and p4 are NOT the county's Summary Page / Schedule A / Schedule B at all but three sheets the filer produced herself in a spreadsheet, headed 'Summary Page', 'Contributions Received' and 'Expenditures Made'. THE SIDES ARE STILL `transcribed` — what is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries (§A2 governs; this is NOT a no-schedule-page). THE LABELS MAP ONE-TO-ONE and that is what makes the per-period anchor safe: her summary's 'This Period' column IS the legacy Column A slot and her 'Year to Date' column IS Column B, and beneath them she reproduces the legacy ladder line for line (Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period / Total Contributions Received / Subtotal / Total Expenditures Made / Balance at Close of Reporting Period) — only the printed line NUMBERS 1-7 are absent. Her schedules also keep the county's own column captions verbatim ('Name of Contributor', 'Mailing Address & Zip Code', 'Amount'), except that Schedule B's payee column is captioned 'Name of Recipient' rather than the county blank's 'Purchased From/Source'. NEITHER of her ledgers has a Purpose column, but she appends the purpose after a hyphen inside the recipient cell on 15 of 16 expenditure rows — the FIRST filing in this chunk from which a purpose can be read at all. FOLIATION: none — no page-of-page box, no page numbers; each of her three sheets is self-identifying by its own printed heading plus her name and the report date '10/28/2014'. This is a further reason the summary page must be located by CONTENT. PAGE-FACE candidate 'Kim Jackson' (Republican, Orem); index.csv names no candidate, so the page face supplies it. Office written on the cover simply as 'Treasurer', which is compatible with (and narrower than) the channel's 'County Treasurer' — recorded, not adjudicated. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; signed and dated 10/28/2014; clerk's date stamp is a faint sideways impression on p1. THIS FILING IS NOT REDACTED — its raw filename carries no '_Redacted' suffix and the county published the candidate's own address block and every donor and vendor address in the clear; the privacy reduction to city/state is therefore mine at READ TIME, exactly as Addendum A §A5 requires, and NOT the county's. TYPED, born-digital-looking sheets scanned to image: still the OCR tier, so row confidence stays 'medium'.
